assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature.
There is a need to correlate clinical events with arrhythmic activity.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture rhythm data during daily activities.
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The patient has unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91).
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204.
The service (mobile cardiac telemetry) is not covered under the payer's determination.
The appeal requests medical necessity review.
The service is mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229).
